title: pp.xycurve
description: `pp.xycurve` provides a GUI for creating and editing an x/y curve of up to 34 control points, with outputs for x, y, total curve length, and control-point coordinates. Send `bang` to draw the curve; in the GUI, click on the right side to add points or the left side to delete them, and hold Ctrl while moving over points to edit them.
